git_tools.Description: Git status, diff, log, and commit for the current vault/repo.

project_git_tools.Description: Git operations (status, fetch, pull, log, diff, add, commit, push, branch, checkout, stash, restore) across the project's repositories. Repos are auto-discovered — use this when working with a project that contains multiple git repos.

github_tools.Description: Read GitHub over the REST API: view a repo, list/view issues and pull requests, list Actions runs. Prompts for and stores a token when a repo is private.

filesystem_tools.Description: Work with files: preview, read, list, search, find, edit, write, and deliver a file to the user as a download. Files live in a filesystem — either a bound project (persistent) or a scratchpad (ephemeral, deleted with the conversation). If you have neither and need to write or juggle files (e.g. to give the user a file), call create_scratchpad first to get an ephemeral filesystem; you do NOT need a project.

coding_tools.Description: Build the current project to verify edits compile.

memory_tools.Description: Recall and correct Ari's personal brain (memory graph). search_brain finds notes by title/alias/content — returns 'title — path' pairs. recall_memory reads the full content of a note by path. edit_memory corrects wrong or inconsistent information in a note and commits the change immediately. neighbours shows graph connections around a note. These tools access Ari's own stored memories, not a project filesystem.

vault_tools.Description: Search an Obsidian note graph within the bound project (regex, no index). Only useful when the project is an Obsidian vault — calling this on a code repository will return nothing. For searching your own memory, use search_brain / recall_memory instead.

project_tools.Description: List, create, rename, and bind projects — the workspaces (code repos or note vaults) a conversation can be scoped to. Use this for any request to start/open/make a new project, workspace, or "project file" — that phrase means a new project, not a file inside one.

persona_tools.Description: Propose a change to your own persona. Load this when the user criticises HOW you replied — your tone, a verbal tic, a habit they find annoying — since promising to change does nothing on its own; your persona is what actually drives your behaviour.

image_tools.Description: Generate images using Stable Diffusion via ComfyUI. Supports text-to-image and img2img (pass reference_images from the user's attachments to guide composition). Prefer higher denoise (0.9–1.0) for creative freedom; lower (0.5–0.75) to stay close to a reference.

discord_tools.Description: Discord voice-channel control: find which VC a user is in, join a voice channel, or leave one.

web_tools.Description: Search the web and read web pages. Use for current events, factual lookups, or anything time-sensitive.
